properties.description: Pins the reply budget on the two reads that outgrew it, over MCP. A scoped loop_status with 80 long-named delivered requirements fits the 30,000-character default, keeps every awaiting id, closing call and evidence id, keeps the count in next and says in budget what it trimmed in awaiting_word; the unscoped answer carries no budget block. An explicit budget_chars of 9,000 is honoured, with rows withheld from the tail and named in lists_shortened (path, shown, total). scan_nodes over 120 long requirements fits 30,000 whole-reply and honours a budget_chars of 5,000, with capped_by size and returned plus omitted equal to the total.
properties.name: tests/a_scoped_loop_status_fits_its_budget.rs
